categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Serum Bio-Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the biopharmaceutical sector focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of antiserum and antitoxin biological products. Its main products include equine tetanus immune globulin (F(ab')2), various antivenoms for snake bites, and rabies immune serum. The company also develops rapid diagnostic reagents related to venom detection and other emergency treatment drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biotechnological methods including toxin proteomics research, antigen purification technology, adjuvant development, immunization and single plasma collection techniques, efficient virus inactivation, pepsin digestion process optimization, column chromatography purification, and antitoxin potency detection technologies. These proprietary technologies ensure the production of safe, effective, and stable emergency treatment antiserum products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are healthcare providers and hospitals requiring emergency treatment drugs for snakebite envenomation, tetanus prevention and treatment, and rabies prophylaxis. The company serves the medical and public health sectors, with products included in national essential medicine and medical insurance catalogs, targeting both urban and rural healthcare markets in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Shanghai and a subsidiary in Jiangsu Province. It has a nationwide marketing and academic promotion network covering major regions in China. Export or overseas market presence is minimal and not a significant revenue contributor.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Serum Bio-Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain. It controls the entire production process from horse immunization and plasma collection (upstream input) through to manufacturing and sales of finished biological products, maintaining full control over its supply chain without outsourcing production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in antiserum and antitoxin products, focusing on new drug development for snake venom and bee venom antidotes, rapid diagnostic reagents for venom detection, and improved manufacturing processes for existing products like rabies immune serum and tetanus immune globulin. It emphasizes upgrading production technology to reduce allergic reactions and improve purity, expanding product lines to cover more biological toxins, and enhancing emergency drug service networks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of biological pharmaceutical products, including antivenoms, immune globulins, and diagnostic reagents. The company uses a distribution model supported by a professional academic promotion team to drive sales through hospitals and healthcare institutions. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position as the sole producer of several antivenom products in China, including antivenoms for major venomous snakes. It competes with a few other domestic producers in the tetanus and rabies immune globulin markets. Its products are recognized for advanced technology and are included in national essential medicine lists, giving it a competitive edge in the emergency treatment drug niche.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 194.9 million, representing a 2.51% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44.29 million, up 14.23%. The company maintains stable total assets around RMB 1.12 billion and net assets of approximately RMB 1.10 billion. It has shown steady growth in sales volume and profitability, with a focus on cost control and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique position as the exclusive domestic producer of key antivenom products, offering safe, effective, and economically priced emergency treatment drugs. Its proprietary technologies and continuous process improvements reduce allergic reactions and improve product quality. The company also highlights its comprehensive product pipeline, academic promotion capabilities, and commitment to expanding access to life-saving treatments in underserved regions.
